The bad news:

  • Most likely not upgradable. Those small form factor PCs tend to have proprietary motherboards which are not guaranteed to fit any upgrades you'd want to put in, other than memory and hard disk, and possibly processor.

  • The upgrade that makes a difference for gaming, a graphics card, most likely won't fit.

  • The specs will not support 3D gaming at 30 FPS unless the graphics scale really low.

The good news:

  • You don't have to build your own. Some people just aren't comfortable with that and don't have anyone to help out, and I get that.

  • You can get PCs that actually have a chance at gaming from Newegg, just navigate to Shop All Stores > Computers & Tablets > Gaming Desktops

  • Don't listen to the haters, go for an AMD processor specifically the A series APU. For within $30 of the one you linked to, you can get a system that stands a decent chance at running games on medium settings at 30 FPS. You'll be able to game.

  • Take this one for example: http://www.newegg.com/Product/Product.aspx?Item=N82E16883272109 This can actually run some of the more recent games and keep close to 30 FPS. It'll mostly likely be upgradable.
